title: The support of a current characterized by compatible approximations G_n → G lies in closure(G(spt X)) (supplied Step 11)
statement: Notation: ℝ^p := Eucl p; D_q(ℝ^p) := GeometricCurrentOn univ q and D^q(ℝ^p) := TestFormOn univ q; spt = support; for a covector γ and a continuous linear map T, γ∘T := γ.compContinuousLinearMap T. Let m, m′, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m), S ∈ D_k(ℝ^{m′}) and G : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, and let G_n : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} (n ∈ ℕ) be continuous maps with G_n → G uniformly on spt X. Assume that for every ω ∈ D^k(ℝ^{m′}) and every sequence (η_n) in D^k(ℝ^m) such that, for all sufficiently large n, there is an open N ⊆ ℝ^m with spt X ⊆ N and η_n(x) = ω(G_n(x))∘(fderiv ℝ G_n x) for all x ∈ N, the sequence X(η_n) converges to S(ω). Then spt S ⊆ closure(G(spt X)).
lean_statement: ∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (G : Eucl m → Eucl m') (Gj : ℕ → Eucl m → Eucl m'), (∀ n, Continuous (Gj n)) → TendstoUniformlyOn Gj G atTop X.support → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k) (ηj : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (ηj n : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (Gj n x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Gj n) x)) → Tendsto (fun n => X (ηj n)) atTop (𝓝 (S ω))) → S.support ⊆ closure (G '' X.support)
